summary: 志在富强，熙宁变法整军理财，元丰改制强干弱枝，然北伐无功、新法争议千年。
summary_en: Determined to make the state strong, he launched the Xining Reforms to rebuild finances and armies and the Yuanfeng reforms to recentralize power, but the northern campaigns failed and the reforms remain debated to this day.

timeline.title: 神宗总评

timeline.summary_en: His will to strengthen the state still polarizes historians; fiscal gains and popular burdens came together.

bio_md:
# 宋神宗 · 主要事迹

赵顼为[[n-song-ying|英宗]]长子，治平四年（1067）即位，时年二十，志在富国强兵。

熙宁二年（1069）起用王安石，设制置三司条例司，青苗、募役、保甲、均输等法次第施行，是为「熙宁变法」。新法理财整军，然扰民与夺利之议相随，朝中变法、保守两派缠斗不休；熙宁九年（1076）王安石再罢相，新法仍行而派内已裂。元丰年间更定官制，史称「元丰改制」，强干弱枝之势愈明。

军事上神宗志在开边：熙河开边取西夏陇右之地，元丰中（1081）五路伐夏，灵州、永乐之役丧师数十万，西征无功而返，神宗闻永乐败讯「临朝痛悼」。

元丰八年（1085）神宗崩，子赵煦即位，高太后临朝，是为[[n-song-zhe|哲宗]]。

bio_parts_en.value:
, ascended in 1067 at twenty, determined to make the state rich and strong.

In 1069 he elevated Wang Anshi, established the Three-Service Finance Commission, and rolled out the green sprouts, hired service, militia, and equal transport laws - the Xining Reforms. They rebuilt finances and armies, but charges of burdening the people and seizing profits followed at once, and the court split into reform and conservative camps. Wang Anshi resigned for good in 1076; the reforms continued while the reform camp itself split. The Yuanfeng restructuring of offices completed the recentralization.

Militarily Shenzong dreamed of expansion: the Xining campaigns opened the Longyou lands of Western Xia, but in 1081 five columns invaded Xia and lost tens of thousands at Lingzhou and Yongle. The western war came to nothing, and the emperor mourned the Yongle disaster openly at court.
